readme:
# FlashAttention-2 延后归一化与行块

## 1. 问题

按查询块流式处理 K/V，维护未归一化输出并返回 logsumexp。

单头方形注意力的 CPU 规格实现，含因果 mask、尾块、数值稳定性与自动微分；不计 GPU warp 时间。

原文: [FlashAttention-2: Faster Attention with Better Parallelism and Work Partitioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.08691) · Section 3.1.1, Algorithm 1; Section 3.3, query-row work partitioning.

## 2. 核心公式

$$
m\leftarrow\max(m,\max_j S_j),\quad \ell\leftarrow e^{m_{old}-m}\ell+\sum_j e^{S_j-m},\quad U\leftarrow e^{m_{old}-m}U+e^{S-m}V,\quad O=U/\ell,\quad L=m+\log\ell.
$$

## 3. 公式到代码

- `flash2_forward(q: Tensor, k: Tensor, v: Tensor, query_block: int, key_block: int, causal: bool = False) -> tuple[Tensor, Tensor]` — Attention output and per-row logsumexp.

外层遍历 Q 的行块，使每块独立拥有输出。内层对 K/V 块更新稳定最大值、分母和未归一化分子。最大值变化时同时重缩放旧分母与分子，结束后一次归一化。

## 4. 本题约定

q,k:(N,D)，v:(N,V)，返回 O:(N,V) 和 L:(N,)。分数包含 1/sqrt(D)。query_block 与 key_block 为正整数；causal=True 时只允许 key_index<=query_index。每行至少能见自身；最后才对 U 除以 l。所有输出保持梯度。

## 5. 交互图

对确定性 13 token、4 维 query/key 和 3 维 value 扫描 5 种不整除块大小，分别测试因果与全注意力，比较稠密结果和 LSE。

T3 使用实际待测函数生成实验，网页参考图使用参考实现。数值来自教学样本，不表示GPU吞吐或完整模型质量。

## 6. 在网页中运行

在右侧 Python 编辑器中补全实现，点击 **运行测试**。查看失败测试的原因、期望值与实际值，修改代码后再次运行。所有必要测试通过后，题目会标记为已完成并解锁坑点讲解。

## 7. 延伸

结合所引章节，解释本题保留了哪些维度、状态或调度约束，再扩展实验样本并保持已有契约。更大模型、真实设备与通信代价需要单独测量。

$$
m\leftarrow\max(m,\max_j S_j),\quad \ell\leftarrow e^{m_{old}-m}\ell+\sum_j e^{S_j-m},\quad U\leftarrow e^{m_{old}-m}U+e^{S-m}V,\quad O=U/\ell,\quad L=m+\log\ell.
$$

## 边界与梯度归属

q,k:(N,D)，v:(N,V)，返回 O:(N,V) 和 L:(N,)。分数包含 1/sqrt(D)。query_block 与 key_block 为正整数；causal=True 时只允许 key_index<=query_index。每行至少能见自身；最后才对 U 除以 l。所有输出保持梯度。

## 独立检验

T0检查接口和无效边界。T1使用手算或独立标量公式。T2检查不变量、状态守恒、有意义的梯度或状态更新原子性。T3把待测实现传入确定性实验，不会导入两个相同参考实现互相比对。

en.readme:
# FlashAttention-2 Delayed Normalization and Query Blocks

## 1. Problem

Stream K/V for each query block, maintaining unnormalized outputs and returning logsumexp.

A CPU specification of single-head square attention, including causal masks, tail blocks, numerical stability and autograd; no GPU warp timing.

Source: [FlashAttention-2: Faster Attention with Better Parallelism and Work Partitioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.08691) · Section 3.1.1, Algorithm 1; Section 3.3, query-row work partitioning.

## 2. Core equations

$$
m\leftarrow\max(m,\max_j S_j),\quad \ell\leftarrow e^{m_{old}-m}\ell+\sum_j e^{S_j-m},\quad U\leftarrow e^{m_{old}-m}U+e^{S-m}V,\quad O=U/\ell,\quad L=m+\log\ell.
$$

## 3. From equations to code

- `flash2_forward(q: Tensor, k: Tensor, v: Tensor, query_block: int, key_block: int, causal: bool = False) -> tuple[Tensor, Tensor]` — Attention output and per-row logsumexp.

Query-row blocks independently own their outputs. Each K/V tile updates a stable maximum, denominator and unnormalized numerator. Rescale both old accumulators when the maximum changes, then normalize once at the end.

## 4. Conventions

q,k:(N,D), v:(N,V), returning O:(N,V) and L:(N,). Scores include 1/sqrt(D). query_block and key_block are positive integers. Causal visibility is key_index<=query_index; each row sees itself. Normalize U by l only after streaming. Both outputs retain gradients.

## 5. Experiment view

Sweep five uneven block sizes on 13 deterministic tokens, four query/key features and three value features, for causal and full attention; compare outputs and LSE with dense execution.

The chart is generated by the actual submitted kernel during T3 and by the reference during export. Values are synthetic teaching measurements, not GPU throughput or full-model quality claims.

## 6. Run your implementation

Complete the functions in the Python editor on the right, then click **Run tests**. Inspect each failed check, update your implementation, and run again. Passing every required check marks the problem as solved and unlocks the notes.

## 7. Further study

Read the cited section and explain which dimensions or scheduling constraints the kernel preserves. Then extend the experiment beyond the stated fixture while retaining the existing contract. Larger models, real devices, and communication costs require separate measurement.
en.notes:
# FlashAttention-2 Delayed Normalization and Query Blocks — Solution notes

## Derivation and implementation

Query-row blocks independently own their outputs. Each K/V tile updates a stable maximum, denominator and unnormalized numerator. Rescale both old accumulators when the maximum changes, then normalize once at the end.

$$
m\leftarrow\max(m,\max_j S_j),\quad \ell\leftarrow e^{m_{old}-m}\ell+\sum_j e^{S_j-m},\quad U\leftarrow e^{m_{old}-m}U+e^{S-m}V,\quad O=U/\ell,\quad L=m+\log\ell.
$$

## Boundary and gradient ownership

q,k:(N,D), v:(N,V), returning O:(N,V) and L:(N,). Scores include 1/sqrt(D). query_block and key_block are positive integers. Causal visibility is key_index<=query_index; each row sees itself. Normalize U by l only after streaming. Both outputs retain gradients.

## Independent checks

T0 checks the callable contract and invalid boundaries. T1 uses hand calculations or an independent scalar formulation. T2 checks invariances, state conservation, gradients when meaningful, or atomic state changes. T3 invokes the supplied implementation in the deterministic experiment; it does not compare two imports of the same reference.

## Behavioral experiment

Sweep five uneven block sizes on 13 deterministic tokens, four query/key features and three value features, for causal and full attention; compare outputs and LSE with dense execution.

A CPU specification of single-head square attention, including causal masks, tail blocks, numerical stability and autograd; no GPU warp timing.

### Reference calibration

Deterministic CPU fixture; Python 3.14.2, PyTorch 2.14.1.

| Metric | Reference value |
| --- | ---: |
| maximum_output_error | 8.8817842e-16 |
| maximum_lse_error | 3.5527137e-15 |

## Common mistakes

- m1_missing_numerator_rescale: A new running maximum requires rescaling old numerator mass.
- m2_unscaled_logits: Removing square-root scaling changes both probabilities and LSE.
